scripts.prisma:generate:if-needed: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const schema=path.join(process.cwd(),'prisma/schema.prisma');const client=path.join(process.cwd(),'node_modules/.prisma/client/index.d.ts');const schemaTime=fs.existsSync(schema)?fs.statSync(schema).mtimeMs:0;const clientTime=fs.existsSync(client)?fs.statSync(client).mtimeMs:0;if(!clientTime||schemaTime>clientTime){console.log('Generating Prisma client...');require('child_process').execSync('prisma generate',{stdio:'inherit'});}else{console.log('Prisma client up to date, skipping generation');}"
